content: {"praised":["Uses period paintings, broadsides, music, and academics.","Narrated by Edward Herrmann, creating a remarkable story.","Covers all aspects of the Revolution, including causes and aftermath.","Best of the bunch, fully outlines the Revolution's scope.","Useful and entertaining for classroom, comparable to Ken Burns."],"criticized":["Biased, portrays founders as rich, wanting British respect.","Interviews mainly with British historians, second‑guessing American Revolution.","Southern theater omitted; missing key battles and figures.","Actors speaking to camera distracting, irritating viewers.","First part claims colonists worshiped king, inaccurate."]}
